partially_covered.missing: Ontology lacks explicit properties for organization meta-data beyond address (e.g., contact info, registration numbers)
No detailed item description or classification properties; only Item and LineItem classes
Invoice details (dates, reference numbers) not explicitly modeled as properties; segments exist but lack data properties

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are addressed through the hierarchy and segment classes, but some lack explicit property-level modeling for full data retrieval (e.g., organization info, item details, invoice meta-data).

issues: Several object properties (e.g., :containsMessage, :hasSegment, :hasAddress, :assignedTo, :hasAgentRole, :hasParticipant, :alignsWith, :processes, :validates) lack rdfs:label and rdfs:comment

strengths: Deep and well-structured class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT envelope/message/segment/data element structure
Good coverage for roles and reification patterns

reasoner_risks: None detected for OWL 2 DL datatypes
Potential for incomplete reasoning due to lack of property characteristics and restrictions

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit properties to Organization (e.g., hasContactInfo, hasRegistrationNumber) and Item (e.g., hasDescription, hasClassification) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved CQ coverage for organization and item details.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add rdfs:label and rdfs:comment annotations to all object properties for full documentation and OOPS compliance.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better validator compatibility and ontology readability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce property characteristics (e.g., functional, inverse) and basic restrictions (owl:someValuesFrom, owl:allValuesFrom) for key relations such as hasAddress, hasSegment.
Add equivalence axioms and GCAs for complex class definitions (e.g., define InvoiceMessage equivalently as a Message with header, detail, summary).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Richer axiomatization and more precise class semantics.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Address modeling with sub-properties (street, city, postal code) and add temporal properties for invoice dates.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: More granular data modeling and CQ10 coverage.

summary: The ontology provides a strong structural foundation for EDIFACT invoice messages, with deep class hierarchies and clear segmentation. However, property-level detail and annotations are missing, limiting full CQ coverage and validator compatibility. Improvements in property characteristics, restrictions, and documentation will significantly enhance quality and completeness.
